title: Otto Skorzeny in the same building as Ruark and Sicre

tellings.quote: Who lives in the same building as Roark and Sicre? Otto Skorzeny.

plain: In Spain, two men named Robert Ruark and Ricardo Sicre are said to have lived in the same building as Otto Skorzeny, the Nazi commando who settled there after the war. Jason Simosa, a researcher, puts it to Michels as a pointed question, "Who lives in the same building as Roark and Sicre? Otto Skorzeny", without naming a source, as a sign that these men moved in the same circles.
